```plato

// A per-pixel scene-depth image. Depths are normalized to [0, 1] between the
// Near and Far distances that produced them.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Depth_map)
type DepthImage
    implements IImage
{
    Size: IntegerSize2D;
    Depths: Array<Number>;
    Near: Number;
    Far: Number;
}
```
